answer: Each identity must keep a living sonnet: a chain of fourteen linked service exchanges with fourteen different strangers, each line signed by both parties and hashing the line before it, renewed every epoch. Every completed line earns one plume, a signed feather-receipt that fades unless the chain keeps growing. A velvet queue holds any identity with a broken link until it repairs the chain with fresh strangers. One fake needs fourteen strangers and fourteen live services; a hundred fakes need fourteen hundred, each chain keyed to its owner so no line can be copied across clones.
